headline: Charlie Munger’s Only Outside Manager Just Sold a Bank to Buy the Companies That Rate Banks
summary: Charlie Munger's only trusted outside manager just made a striking move in financial services, abandoning a position in one of America's biggest banks to load up on the companies that sit above the entire credit system and collect fees no matter who wins or loses.
